issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-c617f954 umbrella, child 2 of 4 (blocked by child 1, the audit). Exercises the fixture-loading and schema-validation half of the harness and completes anything the audit found missing.

## Scope
tests/attempts_mod.rs loading and validation surface: load_old_checkpoint, load_new_checkpoint, load_checkpoint_jsonl, load_old_manifest, load_new_manifest, load_manifest, detect_fixture_format, validate_old_format, validate_new_format.

## Tasks
- Run the loading functions against tests/fixtures/attempts/old and /new; record verbatim results (record counts, manifest fields)
- Confirm validate_old_format and validate_new_format return success on the shipped fixtures, and that detect_fixture_format discriminates Old vs New
- If child 1's audit found gaps in loading or validation, implement them in tests/attempts_mod.rs; commit on main per repo rules (stage precise paths, commit and push in one call)
- If a validator is wrongly strict or lenient against the shipped fixtures, fix it and record what changed

## Acceptance
- Old-format fixtures load and validate; new-format fixtures load and validate; format detection returns Old for old/ and New for new/ — each claim backed by verbatim recorded output in notes
- Any code change is committed and pushed to origin main with paths named in the commit
- cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean for touched code (full gate run is child 4's job)

issue.description:
Outcome: automation can create a bead and consume its structured fields in one invocation.
Scope: Add JSON output for create while preserving the existing plain ID response.
Acceptance:
- create --json emits the newly created issue as one JSON object.
- Plain create continues to print only the created ID.
- Focused conformance tests parse the object and verify its ID matches the created issue.

issue.close_reason:
Build circuit beadrs-21f77073 diagnosed and repaired. The circuit itself was a HEAD-move race: between captured revision 0abe7980 and a236e1a4 only two .beads checkpoint-chore commits landed (74fb559, a236e1a). But verifying main exposed a real, environment-independent break: tests/sync_commit.rs drives 'bead sync commit' under GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM=/dev/null, and src/service/git_commit.rs run_git passes no identity, so six tests failed with git's 'Please tell me who you are' (pre-fix extraction run of scripts/definition-of-done.sh: fmt OK, clippy -D warnings OK, cargo test FAILED 4 passed/6 failed, exit=1). Repair: commit 2949efa gives the test's bead() helper an env identity (GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_*), which the config scrub does not touch — the same host-independent contract the suite's git helper pins with -c user.* flags. Only tests/sync_commit.rs was committed (pathspec commit); the pre-staged .beads/checkpoint/* entries in the shared tree belong to the checkpoint process and were left untouched. Checklist: (1) git status --short reviewed before staging — only pre-existing .beads staged entries plus my tests/sync_commit.rs edit; (2) committed HEAD 2949efa extracted to /var/tmp/beadrs-verify-fixed-Bl5G, full scripts/definition-of-done.sh (fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test) PASSED and the extraction was removed on success; (3) acceptance: repaired main verifies — the previously failing suite now passes 10/10 and the full definition of done passes; (4) pushed 491f00e..2949efa to Forgejo origin, git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty; (5) closing.

verified:

scripts/definition-of-done.sh exit=0
